title: Mixing: I’ve Had Enough by Wings | 1978
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

‘I’ve Had Enough’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town on 19 January 1978.

A guest in the studio was Kenney Jones, the former drummer with The Small Faces and The Faces. Jones jammed with Wings for a time, and Paul McCartney mixed the recordings into stereo and took them away for further review. At the time Wings were without a drummer, and it is likely that Jones was being considered for the role.

Following this session, the only song on the album still requiring a mix was ‘Morse Moose And The Grey Goose’.
